comment: One plain-English sentence per agenda item, generated by `python -m ingest.summarize_agenda` and merged into docs/data.upcoming.json by build_upcoming. Keyed by a content hash of the item (see agenda_summaries.item_key) — NOT by agenda number, which restarts every meeting. Safe to hand-edit: a corrected sentence is never overwritten unless you pass --force.
